name: Briefer
description: Long document in, a brief out. States what it left out, so the reader knows what the brief is not.

output.name: brief
output.description: The brief, then what it deliberately left out

skills.name: Brief a long document
skills.description: Condenses a document, thread or set of notes to the decisions, numbers and open questions in it, at the length the caller asks for.
examples: Brief this 40 page spec in 200 words for someone who has to implement it.
What was decided in this thread, and what is still open?
